track_a.question: Why does the corrected intrinsic kernel still fail to reproduce Yellow's first-event response?

A1_target_semantics.A1a_burley_scale: flat-plane render with the Lego Yellow material and a sharp shadow edge (sun, 4096 spp): fit the Burley length d per channel from the radiance decay into the shadow; compare with the Cycles 3.x Burley parameterisation (compatible mean free path 0.25/pi x radius, albedo fitting 1.9 - A + 3.5 (A - 0.8)^2) and with worklog 44's 'red radius 1 m' reading
A1_target_semantics.A1b_entry_semantics: Burley oracle (A3) with three source sets: all Lego surfaces (object-scoped disk projection), Yellow surfaces only, the receiver's connected component only; which reproduces first_r1 Yellow best on the test views

track_a.A2_localisation: K_k44P K-only Yellow error vs first_r1 on all 16 held-out T0 views: by lit / shadow, by 3-D distance from the pixel's port to the nearest sun-lit Lego port (bins 0-1, 1-3, 3-10, 10-30, >30 cm), by channel, by view (sun elevation), by receiver normal vs sun angle
track_a.A3_input_vs_operator: physics oracle without learning: L_c(x) = s_c * sum_ports R_c(|x - x'|) E_sun(x') A(x'), E_sun from the verified port field (eval_vis_k44 fractions, 0.3 mm rule), R_c Burley with d_c from A1a; s_c (one scalar per channel) fitted on views 0-7, scored on views 8-15 against first_r1 Yellow pixels; compared with K_k44P on the same pixels. PRIMARY COMPARISON A: PSNR(oracle) vs PSNR(K_k44P) on test-view Yellow pixels (shadow and lit separately), bootstrap 95 % CI over views
track_a.A4_representation: transport mass of the Burley profile within 5 cm / 30 cm / beyond per channel; singular-value energy of the port-to-port Burley operator (receivers subsampled, sources = 8 cm coarse ports) at rank 64; K_k44P Yellow component split (loc / glob / band / mid) vs the oracle's near / mid / far split; existing noise floors (first_r1 Yellow floor 29.3-29.7 dB)

track_b.question: Does the frozen C transport a known outgoing field correctly, and where does K/C composition lose accuracy?
track_b.B1_contract_audit: code reading of r1_relations / r1_solve (gathers, hit mapping, inside faces, misses, sender isotropy, units) + relation-table statistics (miss, enclosed, hit-distance distribution, fraction of hits closer than 0.3 mm)
track_b.B2_C_single_flight: regime emit45: Blender renders of held-out T0 views 6 and 15 where every non-Yellow Lego / box surface emits an analytic field f(x) for non-camera rays and is diffuse white for camera rays; Yellow keeps its real material for camera rays and does not emit. Oracle E_in(pixel) = pi (P - P_emit(x)). C prediction at the pixel's port: production (f at the hit port origin) and hit-point values (f at the exact hit point, removes output projection). PRIMARY COMPARISON B: pooled ratio, median |relative error| and correlation of E_C vs E_in on opaque / glass / box pixels, by material and by hit-distance class

B3_composition.B3a_one_step_K_on_verified_field: K_k44P applied to the C-gathered emit45 field (sun off, one step) vs the emit45 Blender radiance of Yellow pixels (the same render; Yellow's SSS response to a free-space incident field)
B3_composition.B3b_iterations: K_k44P solve at held-out T0 views 6 / 15: gathered irradiance by iteration and material, energy growth, residual vs radiometric error against full_r1 - first_r1
B3_composition.B3c_opaque_verified_field: full-GI renders of views 6 / 15 (r1 settings) with diffuse indirect / colour passes: E_ind(pixel) = pi x DiffInd for opaque receivers; FNTO's gathered E_ind at the same pixels vs E_ind; K's receiver response rho_K E_ind / pi vs full_r1 - first_r1

track_b.B4_edit: T1 vs T0 at matched Lego pixels: direct / intrinsic change, indirect change (updated, stale), signed reference indirect change; sign, spatial correlation, magnitude ratio, stationary preservation, excess energy
track_b.B5_material: indirect component by Yellow / opaque / glass / box and edited vs stationary, tracked to K-only error, C error (B2), K response error (B3a/c) and iteration (B3b)

integration: results/fnto_diag45/integration/: each major error classified as K intrinsic / C free-flight / K-C interface / composition-solver / data-reference / unresolved, with the evidence; consistency check between tracks

rules.no_thresholds_after_results: results are reported with bootstrap CIs; no pass / fail threshold is introduced after seeing them
rules.oracles: every oracle is a non-deployable control; none feeds T1 evaluation or any parameter
rules.independence: the emit45 oracle uses Blender's own ray tracing on the true geometry, not C's relation tables or projection; the Burley oracle uses no learned parameter
rules.visibility: the worklog-44 0.3 mm rule is not propagated into C; B1 reports C's near-hit statistics only

tests_before_decisive_runs: emission calibration: a single emissive plane of strength 1 -> pixel radiance (unit c)
oracle render smoke on one view at low spp: finite, P >= P_emit on receivers, Yellow non-emitting
Burley oracle: normalisation of R over the plane (integral 1 for each channel), zero input -> zero output
C evaluation: zero field -> zero, constant field on a closed hemisphere geometry -> E = pi c f
stop: integrated report + worklog 45; no correction implemented; no successor batch
